characterList.description: A young man with short black hair, wearing a blue button-up shirt over a white t-shirt. He is seated in a green chair in a brightly lit space with other chairs and tables nearby.
characterList.name: Wan Hazmer

content_metadata.description: A video featuring Wan Hazmer discussing his journey to becoming a game designer at Square Enix in Tokyo.

qAndA.question: What specific games does Wan Hazmer mention being interested in?
How long did Wan Hazmer study Japanese in Malaysia before going to Japan?

qAndA.answer: It took him one and a half years.
qAndA.question: How long did it take him to learn fluent Japanese in Japan?

qAndA.answer: He saved money, taught at universities, and entered flash game competitions.
qAndA.question: Besides studying Japanese, what else did Wan Hazmer do to prepare for his move to Japan?

qAndA.answer: He emphasizes the importance of determination, perseverance, and being willing to take risks and make sacrifices. He stresses the need to go 'all the way' and not give up halfway ('chuto hampa').
qAndA.question: What message does Wan Hazmer convey about achieving dreams?

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces himself and his current role.
Discusses his early game development experiences in Malaysia and his desire to improve his design skills.
Talks about his interest in Japanese games and his determination to learn how they were made.
Explains his efforts to learn Japanese, his struggles to understand Japanese media, and his decision to study in Japan.
Recounts his journey to Japan, his rapid language learning, and his success in landing a job at Square Enix.
Shares his advice for aspiring game designers, emphasizing the importance of determination and pursuing one's goals all the way.
